KFAC.description: Effective Length Factor (KFAC). Keyed by element id (the element must already exist in the model); sets the effective length factors about the member's major (Ky) and minor (Kz) axes for AIJ-ASD02 design. Requires the AIJ-ASD02 steel design code to be activated first via PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO. The AIJ-ASD02 handler exposes only Ky and Kz: Kt is neither read nor written by this code. DELETE removes the K-factor assignment from the element.

Ky.description: Effective length factor about the major (y) axis.

Kz.description: Effective length factor about the minor (z) axis.

Kt.description: Effective length factor for torsional buckling (ignored by this code: AIJ-ASD02 neither stores nor returns Kt).
